title: Regularity descends along flat local homomorphisms
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(S,\mathfrak m_S)$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local rings and $\varphi:R\to S$ a local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)\subseteq\mathfrak m_S$). If $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $S$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], then $R$ is a regular local ring.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00OF (lemma-flat-under-regular, line 27188) and its proof: a finite free resolution of the residue field kappa of R truncated at d = dim S, tensored with S (flatness), K_d tensor S finite free by Proposition Tag 00O7 (proposition-regular-finite-gl-dim) and Lemma Tag 00O5 (lemma-independent-resolution), K_d finite free by Lemma Tag 00O1 (lemma-finite-projective-descends), so kappa has finite projective dimension and R is regular by Proposition Tag 00OC (proposition-finite-gl-dim-regular, Serre)

proof.text: (A finite free resolution of $\kappa$ truncated at $d=\dim S$.) Let $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m_R$, $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$, and $d=\dim S$, which is finite since $S$ is a Noetherian local ring [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-system-of-parameters]. The $R$-module $\kappa$ is generated by $1$, so by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-free-resolution-noetherian] ($R$ Noetherian) there is an exact complex $\cdots\to F_1\to F_0\to\kappa\to0$ with $F_i=R^{\oplus n_i}$ finite free. Put $F_{-1}=\kappa$ and define $K=\kappa$ if $d=0$ and $K=\operatorname{Ker}(F_{d-1}\to F_{d-2})$ if $d\ge1$ (for $d=1$, $K=\operatorname{Ker}(F_0\to\kappa)$). Then $0\to K\to F_{d-1}\to\dots\to F_0\to\kappa\to0$ is exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] (injective at $K$ as $K\to F_{d-1}$ is an inclusion, exact at $F_{d-1}$ by the definition of $K$, exact elsewhere because the resolution is), and $K$ is a finitely generated $R$-module: for $d\ge1$ it is a submodule of the finitely generated $F_{d-1}$ over the Noetherian ring $R$ [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-submodule-finite], for $d=0$ it is $\kappa$.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00OF (lemma-flat-under-regular, line 27188), lines 27196-27212, sentences 1-3 ('Choose any resolution ... Set K_d = Ker(F_{d-1} -> F_{d-2})'); the case d = 0 and the finiteness of K_d are written out here

proof.text: (Tensoring with $S$.) $S$ is a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], so applying [lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact] at each place of the exact sequence of Step 1 (with the zero modules at its ends) shows that $0\to K\otimes_RS\to F_{d-1}\otimes_RS\to\dots\to F_0\otimes_RS\to\kappa\otimes_RS\to0$ is an exact sequence of $S$-modules. Each $F_i\otimes_RS\cong S^{\oplus n_i}$ is a finite free, hence projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], $S$-module.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00OF (lemma-flat-under-regular, line 27188), lines 27196-27212, sentence 4 ('By flatness of R -> S the complex ... is still exact')

proof.text: ($K\otimes_RS$ is projective over $S$.) $S$ is a regular local ring of dimension $d$, so by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-finite-gl-dim] (Stacks 00O7) every $S$-module, in particular $\kappa\otimes_RS$, has a projective resolution of length $\le d$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-projective-resolution-kernel-projective] (Stacks 00O5) over $S$ to $M=\kappa\otimes_RS$ and the exact sequence of Step 2: if $d\ge1$, with $e=d-1\ge d-1$ and the projective modules $F_i\otimes_RS$, the kernel of $F_{d-1}\otimes_RS\to F_{d-2}\otimes_RS$ (resp. of $F_0\otimes_RS\to\kappa\otimes_RS$ if $d=1$), which is the image of the injection from $K\otimes_RS$, is projective; if $d=0$, $K\otimes_RS=\kappa\otimes_RS$ is projective by the case $d=0$ of that lemma. So $K\otimes_RS$ is a projective $S$-module.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00OF (lemma-flat-under-regular, line 27188), lines 27196-27212, sentence 5 ('Because the global dimension of S is d, see Proposition 00O7, we see that K_d tensor S is a finite free S-module (see also Lemma 00O5)')

proof.text: ($K$ is finite free over $R$.) $\varphi$ is a flat local homomorphism of local rings and $K$ is a finitely generated $R$-module (Step 1) with $K\otimes_RS$ projective over $S$ (Step 3); by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-descends-flat-local] (Stacks 00O1), $K$ is a finite free $R$-module, in particular projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module].

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00OF (lemma-flat-under-regular, line 27188), lines 27196-27212, sentence 6 ('By Lemma 00O1 we see that K_d is a finite free R-module')

proof.text: ($\kappa$ has finite projective dimension.) By Steps 1 and 4, $0\to K\to F_{d-1}\to\dots\to F_0\to\kappa\to0$ is an exact sequence with all terms except $\kappa$ projective (for $d=0$ it reads $0\to\kappa\to\kappa\to0$ with $\kappa=K$ projective), i.e. a projective resolution of $\kappa$ of length $\le d$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]; so $\kappa$ has finite projective dimension.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00OF (lemma-flat-under-regular, line 27188), lines 27196-27212, sentence 7 ('Hence kappa has finite projective dimension')

proof.text: ($D=\dim R$ is finite and $\kappa$ has a projective resolution of length $\le D$.) $D=\dim R$ is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-system-of-parameters]. By Step 5 and [lem-weil-pbc-residue-field-pd-le-krull-dimension] (Stacks 00OB), $\operatorname{pd}_R\kappa\le D$: $\kappa$ has a projective resolution $0\to P_D\to\dots\to P_0\to\kappa\to0$ of length $\le D$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension].

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00OF, sentence 7 ('R is regular by Proposition 00OC'); Proposition Tag 00OC (proposition-finite-gl-dim-regular, line 27096), proof of (1) => (3), lines 27111-27115 (Lemma Tag 00OB lemma-dim-gl-dim)

proof.text: ($D\ge\dim_\kappa\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$.) Let $n=\dim_\kappa\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-residue-field-pd-ge-embedding-dimension] (Stacks 00OA) to the projective resolution of $\kappa$ of length $\le D$ from Step 6 gives $D\ge n$.

source.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 00OC, proof of (1) => (3), lines 27111-27114 (Lemma Tag 00OA lemma-length-resolution-residue-field)

proof.text: ($\mathfrak m$ is generated by $n$ elements.) $R$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], so $\mathfrak m$ is a finitely generated $R$-module and $\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m\cdot\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$ is a $\kappa$-vector space of dimension $n$. Choose $x_1,\dots,x_n\in\mathfrak m$ whose images form a basis of $\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$; by Nakayama's lemma [lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-local-generators] applied to $M=\mathfrak m$, the $x_i$ generate $\mathfrak m$.

source.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 00OC, proof line 27115 ('Thus R is regular, see Definition regular-local and the discussion preceding it'); the discussion before Definition 00KU (definition-regular-local, line 14615), Lemma 00DV (lemma-NAK)

proof.text: ($R$ is regular.) By Steps 7 and 8, $\mathfrak m$ is generated by $x_1,\dots,x_n$ together with $D-n\ge0$ copies of $0$, that is by $D=\dim R$ elements. As $R$ is a Noetherian local ring, this is the definition of a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme].

source.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 00OC, proof line 27115; Definition Tag 00KU (definition-regular-local)

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks 00OF and kept it; stmt_deps unchanged. Mathlib (LeanSearch, LeanFinder, Loogle, local search, grep) has no descent of IsRegularLocalRing along flat maps and no Serre characterisation, so the node is split following the Stacks proof in nine steps: finite free resolution of kappa (existing lem-weil-pbc-finite-free-resolution-noetherian, 00LP) truncated at d = dim S, with the case d = 0 (K = kappa) and the finiteness of K (Noetherian submodule leaf) written out; exactness after tensoring with S (Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact); K tensor S projective by 00O7 (existing unsplit lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-finite-gl-dim) and 00O5 (new unsplit lem-weil-pbc-projective-resolution-kernel-projective); K finite free by 00O1 (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-descends-flat-local, a one-term composition of FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom, Flat.of_flat_tensorProduct and free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing); kappa of finite projective dimension; then 00OC (1) => (3) exactly as in lem-weil-pbc-finite-gl-dim-regular-local: pd kappa <= dim R (00OB node), dim m/m^2 <= pd (00OA node), Nakayama, definition. Stacks says 'K_d tensor S is finite free'; only projectivity is needed and used for 00O1.
